title: Cardiac emergency — adult male
narrative: Caller reports her 62-year-old husband collapsed in the kitchen at 418 Maple Avenue, Apt 2B. He is on the floor, pale, clutching his chest, and breathing is irregular. She is alone with him and very distressed. No AED known on site.

extract.chief_complaint: Adult male collapse with chest pain / irregular breathing

title: Structure fire — residential
narrative: Passerby reports heavy smoke and flames showing from the second floor of a two-story house at 920 Birch Street. Neighbor says an elderly resident may still be inside. Dogs barking in backyard. Wind blowing toward the attached garage.

extract.chief_complaint: Residential structure fire with possible trapped occupant

title: MVC — intersection with injuries
narrative: Two-car crash at Oak & 5th. Silver sedan vs delivery van. One driver bleeding from forehead, still in vehicle, door won't open. Other driver out walking. Traffic blocked eastbound. Smell of gasoline reported.

extract.chief_complaint: Two-vehicle MVC with injury and possible entrapment
